usage: Baseline coverage, not an exhaustive or timeless policy oracle. Evaluate every requested platform pair; add checks for current triggered rules. Obligations are seeds; explain release-specific overrides with current sources.

checks.title: Establish a native release candidate
checks.verify: Identify actual mobile target, artifact, build provenance and supported devices; desktop/web alone cannot pass.

checks.title: Inventory all features and review surfaces
checks.verify: Map screens, extensions, web views, backend, data recipients, core tasks and store claims.

checks.title: Verify current policy and deadline applicability
checks.verify: Open current policy sections and deadlines for release date, account, markets and form factors; record conflicts.

checks.title: Complete publisher identity and agreements
checks.verify: Confirm store enrollment, roles, verified contact and required agreements; banking/tax where monetized.

checks.trigger: Selected markets, service type and distribution
checks.title: Resolve geographic and regulatory declarations
checks.verify: Check trader/export/licensing, local privacy/consumer/accessibility requirements and relevant store permits.

checks.title: Meet current SDK and deployment upload rules
checks.verify: Inspect archive SDK/toolchain and deployment target separately against current Apple upload deadlines.

checks.title: Validate signing, identifiers and archive
checks.verify: Confirm team/provisioning, unique build/version, capabilities and successful distribution archive validation/processing.

checks.title: Align purpose strings, entitlements and permission behavior
checks.verify: Map actual resource use to descriptions/capabilities; test denial, revocation and supported alternatives.

checks.title: Meet equivalent privacy-preserving login rule
checks.verify: Inspect login service behavior and specific guideline 4.8 exemptions; test qualifying equivalent login when required.

checks.title: Provide justified guest access
checks.verify: Assess whether mandatory account/personal data is relevant to core functionality; verify usable guest path where required.

checks.title: Determine encryption export compliance
checks.verify: Answer actual encryption questionnaire; provide required documents or justified exemption declaration, not an automatic false flag.

checks.title: Use allowed APIs, code and update mechanisms
checks.verify: Inspect public/private APIs, downloaded code, plugins and reviewable functionality against platform-specific rules and exceptions.

checks.title: Declare trader status and applicable contact verification
checks.verify: Record declared status; verify contact display/evidence when trader and EU distribution triggers it.

checks.title: Test intended candidate via TestFlight
checks.verify: Record distribution build, core flow coverage, feedback and external beta review where used.

checks.trigger: iPad, extensions, Mac/vision compatibility or extra device families enabled
checks.title: Review every enabled Apple target
checks.verify: Test target-specific layouts, capabilities, privacy, accessibility, assets and opt-in distribution compatibility.

checks.title: Meet target API rules for this release
checks.verify: Verify targetSdk against new/update deadline, device-type exceptions and confirmed console extensions.

checks.title: Validate signed app bundle and version identity
checks.verify: Inspect release AAB, package/version code, signing configuration, Play App Signing and processing results.

checks.trigger: Native code present directly or through SDKs
checks.title: Verify native 64-bit ABI support
checks.verify: Inspect packaged libraries and generated APKs; test applicable 64-bit devices and policy exceptions.

checks.title: Verify 16 KB memory-page compatibility
checks.verify: Inspect all native dependencies/alignment and run actual 16 KB environment tests; verify current enforcement date.

checks.title: Use supported Billing Library version
checks.verify: Inspect resolved/package billing dependency and live deadlines; confirm approved extension if relying on it.

checks.title: Inspect merged release manifest and sensitive APIs
checks.verify: Review actual permission/component declarations, necessity, SDK-added entries and policy-compliant use.

checks.trigger: Restricted permissions, APIs or foreground services
checks.title: Complete applicable declarations and approvals
checks.verify: Research each used permission/service's policy; attach accurate explanations, demos and approval evidence.

checks.title: Check sensitive accessibility API eligibility
checks.verify: Verify declaration, disclosure and autonomous-action limits/exemptions; do not confuse with accessible UI support.

checks.trigger: New personal account subject to production-access rules
checks.title: Complete required closed test and production application
checks.verify: Confirm account date/type, continuously opted-in testers/duration, useful feedback and actual production approval.

checks.title: Complete Play account and real-device verification
checks.verify: Check account-specific verification notices and proof; distinguish from closed-testing gate.

checks.title: Verify developer identity and package registration
checks.verify: Check selected markets/stores/devices and signing registration under current Android verification rollout.

checks.title: Review pre-launch, pre-review and compatibility findings
checks.verify: Collect release-track results and SDK/compatibility warnings; reproduce and resolve relevant failures.

checks.title: Preserve navigation and lifecycle state
checks.verify: Test back/predictive back, rotation, process death, keyboard/insets, background/foreground and transaction state.

checks.trigger: Tablets, foldables, desktop, TV, Wear, automotive or XR supported
checks.title: Review adaptive and special-device branches
checks.verify: Open dedicated quality/distribution rules and test enabled form factors; add detailed checks and required assets.

checks.title: Finish usable advertised functionality
checks.verify: Exercise onboarding and all advertised core flows with reviewer-accessible backend; remove placeholders and dead links.

checks.title: Resolve crashes and broken core flows
checks.verify: Run release candidate on supported minimum/current OS and representative real devices; record failures and regression results.

checks.title: Handle offline, loading, empty and error states
checks.verify: Test slow/failing networks, retry, cancellation, interrupted auth/payments and useful user-visible feedback.

checks.title: Test upgrades, migrations and resource behavior
checks.verify: Verify reinstall/update/migrations, startup, rendering, memory, battery and background resource use on core flows.

checks.trigger: Permission requests, push or protected resource use
checks.title: Honor permission choices and contextual disclosure
checks.verify: Request only needed scope; test denial/revocation, alternatives, notification controls and unexpected-data consent.

checks.trigger: Links, sharing, media, widgets or device integrations
checks.title: Exercise native integrations and interruptions
checks.verify: Verify link routing, shares, keyboard/audio focus and external return paths; research feature-specific rules.

checks.title: Verify localization, right-to-left and layout resilience
checks.verify: Test languages, long text, orientation, display scaling and supported screen sizes without losing core actions.

checks.title: Test release configuration and backend compatibility
checks.verify: Inspect production endpoints, feature flags, debug-only behavior, backend versions and release observability.

checks.title: Inventory actual app and SDK data handling
checks.verify: Trace code/runtime flows, data types, providers, purposes, retention/deletion and collection before consent.

checks.title: Publish an accurate accessible privacy policy
checks.verify: Reconcile implementation/SDKs with public and in-app policy, identity/contact, recipients, retention/deletion and choices.

checks.title: Complete App Store privacy answers
checks.verify: Apply Apple's collection, purposes, identity/tracking and partner definitions; verify answers against full data inventory.

checks.trigger: Production release or other covered tracks
checks.title: Complete Play Data safety and deletion answers
checks.verify: Apply Play collection/sharing/exemption definitions and all SDKs; verify security/deletion answers and public privacy URL.

checks.trigger: Required-reason APIs or applicable SDK requirements
checks.title: Supply correct app and SDK privacy manifests
checks.verify: Inspect actual API categories/reasons, target packaging, tracking declarations and required SDK signatures.

checks.trigger: Personal/sensitive data collection requiring consent or unexpected use
checks.title: Provide required disclosure and affirmative consent
checks.verify: Check timing, wording, recipients, scope and revocation; ensure no collection starts before required consent.

checks.title: Meet tracking and advertising consent rules
checks.verify: Apply store definitions and age restrictions; inspect identifiers/SDK initialization and accurately disclose actual practices.

checks.trigger: Accounts, stored personal data or linked creation
checks.title: Implement account and associated-data deletion
checks.verify: Test in-app request through backend/processor completion, identity safeguards, retained exceptions and subscription implications.

checks.title: Provide working external deletion request resource
checks.verify: Test public request path without installed app, app/developer identity and clear associated-data deletion instructions.

checks.trigger: Personal data sent to external AI providers
checks.title: Disclose AI sharing and obtain required permission
checks.verify: Identify recipient/routing and clear pre-transfer consent; tool execution approval is a separate control.

checks.trigger: Sensitive storage, account or network use
checks.title: Review credentials, transport and access boundaries
checks.verify: Inspect Keychain/Keystore use, TLS/authz, token revocation, logs/backups and web-view/deep-link trust boundaries.

checks.title: Review dependency and execution risks
checks.verify: Inspect supported dependencies, vulnerable SDK notices, dynamic tool/code behavior, bridges and user action controls.

checks.title: Complete core tasks with screen reader
checks.verify: Run VoiceOver/TalkBack matrix including login, purchase, settings and deletion; inspect names/roles/states/order and updates.

checks.title: Support keyboard, switches and voice interaction
checks.verify: Test actionable controls, alternate gestures, visible focus, modal trap/restore and no inaccessible overlays.

checks.title: Support large text, zoom and display scaling
checks.verify: Exercise accessibility text sizes/reflow across locales, devices and web views; avoid lost content/actions.

checks.title: Measure contrast and non-color meaning
checks.verify: Inspect actual foreground/background colors, essential UI states and charts in relevant appearances/settings.

checks.title: Provide usable touch targets and gesture alternatives
checks.verify: Measure hit areas/spacing against appropriate platform targets; test non-drag and nonprecision alternatives.

checks.title: Respect reduced motion, timing and flashing needs
checks.verify: Test reduced motion, pause/stop, time adjustment and safe content while preserving task meaning.

checks.title: Provide accessible media and input alternatives
checks.verify: Verify captions, transcripts, descriptions and text alternatives for relevant common tasks.

checks.title: Make forms and errors accessible
checks.verify: Check persistent labels, error announcements, instructions, autofill/paste, recovery and understandable confirmations.

checks.title: Combine automated audit with manual workflow testing
checks.verify: Collect Inspector/native automated results and assistive-technology task recordings; never equate zero scan issues with full access.

checks.title: Evaluate voluntary device-specific accessibility labels
checks.verify: Use current feature criteria and common-task evidence per supported device; omit unproved claims.

checks.trigger: Public accessibility claims or support materials
checks.title: Document truthful accessibility support and limitations
checks.verify: Create tested-support matrix/statement, setting instructions and contact; verify support/privacy/deletion website accessibility.

checks.trigger: Any payments, digital unlocks or subscriptions
checks.title: Classify purchase and allowed billing route by storefront
checks.verify: Identify digital/physical service, location and current exceptions/programs before requiring or allowing external payment.

checks.title: Configure complete reviewable product metadata
checks.verify: Verify product IDs, availability/pricing, localized descriptions, review screenshots/notes and submission status.

checks.title: Disclose subscription, trial, renewal and cancellation terms
checks.verify: Inspect paywall and store copy for actual price/period/trial conversion, privacy/terms and cancellation path.

checks.title: Validate purchase lifecycle, restoration and revocation
checks.verify: Test success/pending/decline, reinstalls/restore, verification, duplicates, renewals, refunds/revocation and interrupted sessions.

checks.title: Answer age/content-rating forms accurately
checks.verify: Inspect complete feature/content inventory and current region-specific questionnaires, not just marketing demographics.

checks.title: Declare ads and target audience accurately
checks.verify: Reconcile ad SDK/runtime behavior, actual intended ages, listing style and all applicable audience requirements.

checks.title: Meet Kids/Families and child-data requirements
checks.verify: Inspect parental controls/consent, content, data/identifiers, allowed SDK/ads and current market obligations.

checks.trigger: Shared user-generated content or social interactions
checks.title: Provide standards, moderation, reporting and blocking
checks.verify: Test applicable content/user reports, blocking, policy acceptance, filtering and actual moderation response path.

checks.title: Prevent prohibited AI output and enable in-app reporting
checks.verify: Confirm scope/exclusions, safeguards and reports delivered without leaving app, with moderation follow-through.

checks.trigger: Social, dating, anonymous/random chat or restricted-age feature
checks.title: Meet child-safety standards and minor-access restrictions
checks.verify: Inspect published standards, feedback, response/reporting procedures, point of contact and appropriate age restrictions.

checks.trigger: Restricted, regulated, news, gambling, donation or other special functionality
checks.title: Research dedicated content and service requirements
checks.verify: Open full applicable policies/market rules; add feature-specific checks and licenses/disclosures/evidence tasks.

checks.title: Complete Health apps declaration including no-features answer
checks.verify: Match full feature and health-data use to actual required form; inspect additional questions if triggered.

checks.title: Complete Financial features declaration including no-features answer
checks.verify: Match actual feature inventory to form; verify further evidence and market licenses if triggered.

checks.title: Supply health claim and regulated-device evidence
checks.verify: Verify methodology/disclaimers, health-data restrictions, operator eligibility and applicable medical/research declarations/licenses.

checks.trigger: Financial services, loans, crypto or tokens
checks.title: Supply financial licenses and truthful disclosures
checks.verify: Research service/market-specific eligibility, license evidence, lending/token restrictions and required metadata.

checks.title: Complete App Store required listing and identity fields
checks.verify: Verify localized name/category, description, keyword bytes, copyright and version information; optional fields remain optional.

checks.title: Complete Play title, descriptions and categorization
checks.verify: Verify title/short/full limits, app/game/free/paid, category/tags and contact/locale configuration.

checks.title: Align listing claims with actual mobile release
checks.verify: Trace claims to shipped flows/build, paid availability, required account/device/network and appropriate audience.

checks.title: Remove misleading or prohibited metadata and affiliations
checks.verify: Inspect all locale copy/assets for false claims, irrelevant keywords, prohibited promotion and rights/affiliation issues.

checks.title: Provide working policy and support contact resources
checks.verify: Verify public policy URL/in-app access and applicable support/contact fields with real approved business facts.

checks.title: Localize copy and material claims consistently
checks.verify: Check field counts, clear language, UI availability, translations and consistent payment/privacy/accessibility claims.

checks.title: Write truthful user-facing release notes
checks.verify: Describe shipped changes using current store fields/limits; first release has different Apple field availability.

checks.title: Supply valid App Store screenshots by supported device
checks.verify: Check required device buckets/fallbacks, accepted dimensions/count/format and no alpha against refreshed specifications.

checks.title: Supply Play icon, feature graphic and screenshots
checks.verify: Validate distinct icon/feature/screenshot specs and general minimum/count/dimensions; inspect supported-device exceptions.

checks.title: Capture truthful licensed and privacy-safe app visuals
checks.verify: Inspect actual mobile UI/build, fictional data, paid feature context, asset rights and audience suitability.

checks.trigger: Multiple locales or supported device types
checks.title: Plan localized readable screenshot narrative
checks.verify: Record captures per device/locale/build, benefit sequence, readable overlays and nonclipped important content.

checks.title: Meet Apple preview format and content rules
checks.verify: Verify duration/resolution/size/codec and actual app footage, audio/captions and poster frame.

checks.title: Meet Play video access and presentation rules
checks.verify: Verify proper public/unlisted embeddable YouTube video without ads or age restriction; actual app depiction.

checks.title: Provide accessible graphic and screenshot alt text
checks.verify: Write meaningful concise asset descriptions in console-supported fields and localize where appropriate.

checks.trigger: Visual assets submitted through relevant content flows
checks.title: Declare applicable AI-generated or edited assets
checks.verify: Assess each image/video under current console/self-declaration rules and applicable labeling scope.

checks.title: Package valid native icons and launch assets
checks.verify: Inspect actual native asset catalogs/resources and rendered icon/launch behavior; store icon is a separate artifact.

checks.title: Supply all form-factor-specific required assets
checks.verify: Research supported TV/watch/Wear/car/XR/tablet specs and quality rather than treating phone assets as sufficient.

checks.trigger: Purchased products, subscriptions or custom terms
checks.title: Prepare applicable terms/EULA and billing help
checks.verify: Choose standard/custom license correctly; verify terms/privacy/cancel/restore links and accurate product disclosures.

checks.trigger: Gated functionality, hardware, unusual flows or paid access
checks.title: Prepare complete private reviewer access instructions
checks.verify: Test fresh reviewer path through every gate; provide secure credentials handoff and dependency/hardware setup notes.

checks.trigger: Licensed content, third-party materials or regulated claims
checks.title: Gather rights, licenses and requested review attachments
checks.verify: Tie provenance and current license/approval evidence to shipped materials and applicable submission requirements.

checks.title: Produce test, disclosure and asset evidence packet
checks.verify: Inventory exact documents/paths/owners, build references and outstanding inputs; synchronize with final native behavior.

checks.title: Clear all applicable mandatory console tasks and review warnings
checks.verify: Inspect current target console/build status and remaining forms; add checks for any unmodeled mandatory task.

checks.title: Select correct build, availability, pricing and publishing behavior
checks.verify: Confirm target artifact, regions/devices/price, release mode and prerequisite approvals with console evidence.

checks.title: Define monitoring, support and release recovery ownership
checks.verify: Assign role-based crash/ANR/backend/billing monitoring, incident response and practical stop/recovery plan.

checks.title: Reconcile final artifacts and close release gates
checks.verify: Recheck code/build, claims, disclosures, console evidence and triggered policies; keep required unknowns open.
